notes: This focused contract records the embedded profile's standards-facing filesystem service-report lifetime invariant. A successful join allocates one RTI-owned file and the file-reporting switches gate only later appends; disabling and re-enabling the switches must not replace the path or lose the joined-federate initial record. The contract is source/API traceability plus native Catch2 evidence only; Requirements-Lab validation, JUnit, protected review, remote transport, package evidence, and conformance remain open.

requirements.notes: The production join path creates the filesystem-backed writer before publishing the joined-federate MOM value and retains that writer for the joined-federate lifetime. The focused regression observes one absolute file at join and the same path after both switch cycles.
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded service-report files retain one joined-federate path across switch cycles

requirements.notes: The routing plan suppresses appends while file reporting is disabled and resumes the same writer when it is enabled again. The focused regression performs a report-producing lookup in each state and verifies that the disabled interval does not change the file set or contents.
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded service-report files retain one joined-federate path across switch cycles
